tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshogs skong bcas bzhugs/1$0000300 oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal mdun gyi mkhar// bka' drin sum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// skyabs gnas kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung*// rtsa gsum lha tshogs sprin ltar gtibs par gsal// hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐:

zhes byin dbab nas badz+ra gu ru'i dzap ci nus bzla/ mthar tshogs mchod ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ snang ba snod kyi gtor gzhong du// srid pa bcud kyi tshogs rdzas bshams// gnyis 'dzin dri ma kun bsal nas// ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur byas te// rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung// rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol// 'khor gsum dmigs pa'i sgrib tshogs kun// ye dag kun bzang klong du bshags// ma rig gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bgegs// sku gsum rol par bsgral nas kyang*// mnyam nyid yangs pa'i zhal du bstab// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// skong ba ni/ hrīḥ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// pad+ma thod phreng dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs// bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam gnyan po bskang*// sdom gsum 'gal ba'i nyes ltung phra rags rnams// dmigs med kun bzang klong du mthol zhing bshags// dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// rang byung ye shes gdod ma'i chos kyi sku /bdag rgyud mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes tshogs mchod rim pa gsum du spros la phul/ sgrub po nang gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas longs spyad pa'i lhag ma ni/ hrīḥ ka dag thig le nyag gcig las// thabs kyi rol pa gtso dang 'khor// rnam 'gyur mi bzad lhag sdud tshogs// lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod// chad mdo ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ dus gsum dus med ka dag dus kyi tshe// shes rig gdod ma'i mgon pos rang snang gi /'khor tshogs rgya mtshor ji ltar bcol pa'i las// bsgrub phyir gtor ma 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// brtan skyong ni/ khyad par rig 'dzin pad+ma sam+bha wa'i// zhal mthong bod yul brtan skyong bcu gnyis po// 'khor bcas bshal chu'i gtor ma 'di longs la// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

dbang blang ba ni/ gu ru mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis// bdag cag mos pa'i bu rnams la// lus la sku yis byin gyis rlobs// ngag la gsung gis byin gyis rlobs// yid la thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs// dbang bzhi bskur bar byin gyis rlobs// rgyud bzhi dag par byin gyis rlobs// lam bzhi 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// sku bzhi thob par byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dhe wa ḍā ki nī/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ rtsa gsum lha tshogs 'od zhu rang la thim// skye ba kun tu o rgyan pad+ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// pad+ma 'byung gnas go 'phang myur thob shog / sogs brjod cing mthar bkra shis dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis chos khrims dkar rin ngor spel ba dge// /
